summary: Cattaraugus County, NY: 54-ft Aermotor tower built about 1940 by the CCC Indian Division on the Allegany Indian Reservation; still stands, open only with the Nation's permission.

facts.design: 54-foot Aermotor tower, the only one of its manufacture and design in New York (NYSFFLA)

access.note: Not accessible to the public without permission from the Nation (NYSFFLA)

facts.agency: Built by the Civilian Conservation Corps Indian Division through the Bureau of Indian Affairs and the New York Indian Agency

events.note: Erected about 1940 by the CCC Indian Division on the Allegany Indian Reservation

notes_for_editor: Two sources only: the NYSFFLA entry (detailed) and the FFLA state list (name, coordinates, standing). Location conflict: NYSFFLA says about 3 miles southwest of Salamanca, but the listed coordinates 42.08896, -78.86361 are about 9.0 miles (great-circle distance, calculated by hand from the city coordinates in source 3, not a quoted figure) from Salamanca's Wikipedia coordinates. Left unresolved; no correction proposed. Erection year: NYSFFLA says about 1940. Facebook group snippets from search (not fetched, not cited) mention a June 1941 steel delivery and a 1941 erection; unverified and left out. The NYSFFLA entry gives no staffing history, so staffing is omitted. The name 'Venison Hill' comes only from the FFLA list (and FB snippets). Permission is from 'the Nation' as NYSFFLA words it; the nation is not named in the sources read. Used 2 WebSearch and about 3 page reads.
